threat_event: Ransomware on business IT halts email, nominations, measurement, and billing, and leadership orders a precautionary pipeline shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No cybersecurity incident response plan or isolation criteria; no OT monitoring to prove OT is unaffected; business backups not immutable
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06; SYS-09; SYS-10; SYS-11; BP-01; BP-04
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(b)(3)); 49 CFR 192.615(a)(6); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.F)
existing_controls: MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting; MFA on email and SaaS; IT/OT firewall and DMZ
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook with the isolate-and-operate decision tree; OT monitoring sensor (R-005); immutable backups (R-019); annual tabletop with controllers

threat_event: Ransomware crosses the DMZ through the shared jump host and encrypts SCADA hosts and HMI consoles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Jump host shared by the integrator and SCADA Engineer; always-on remote access; OT logs not reviewed; HMI OS near end of support
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(c)(4)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.B)
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall pair; separate OT domain with no trust; signature antivirus on HMIs
treatment_plan: Separate jump hosts for vendor and staff access; on-demand vendor sessions with MFA and recording; application allowlisting on HMIs

threat_event: Attacker uses the SCADA integrator's remote access to reach SCADA and issue commands
threat_source: Nation-state or cybercriminal group via a compromised supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared integrator account; no MFA; connection always on; sessions not logged
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(b)(5)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.C.2)
existing_controls: Remote access terminates on the DMZ jump host, not directly in OT
treatment_plan: Named integrator accounts with MFA; access enabled per ticket by the SCADA Engineer and disabled after each session; session recording; contract security terms

threat_event: SCADA server backups are encrypted or lost with production, so SCADA cannot be rebuilt within the 2-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA backups on an online storage device inside OT; no offline copy; never restored to new hardware
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(c)(4)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.F.1.c)
existing_controls: Weekly SCADA image backups; redundant hosts; backup control room
treatment_plan: Monthly offline encrypted copy stored at the compressor station safe; annual bare-metal restore test to spare hardware; configuration export after every change

threat_event: Nation-state actor pre-positions in OT using legitimate tools and is not detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network monitoring; 30-day log retention; no baseline of OT communications
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(e)(1)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.D)
treatment_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor at the SCADA core switch with alerts to the MSP; 1-year log retention; monthly firewall log review

threat_event: Unattributable or unauthorized change on an HMI console or SCADA server using a shared account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared Windows login on 3 HMI consoles; shared SCADA administrator account; passwords unchanged since 2022
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(b)(4)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.C.4)
existing_controls: Individual SCADA application logins for controllers; control room badge access
treatment_plan: Individual administrator accounts; change shared console password and restrict it to the console; password change schedule with documented exceptions

threat_event: Attacker inside OT exploits a known vulnerability in the HMI operating system or SCADA software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI OS near end of support; SCADA software two releases behind; no patch methodology
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(c)(1)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.E)
treatment_plan: Patch methodology prioritizing the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog; SCADA upgrade project with API RP 1165 review (192.631(c)(1)); quarterly OT vulnerability review

threat_event: Attacker logs into a cellular gateway with default credentials and sends commands to a remote valve RTU
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three gateways use the manufacturer default password; web management reachable from the carrier network
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(c)(2)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.C.1)
existing_controls: Carrier private network; RTUs accept commands only from the SCADA host address
treatment_plan: Change all gateway passwords; disable remote web management; add gateways to the asset inventory

threat_event: A SCADA display or point change shows a wrong value or wrong point, and the controller acts on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two 2026 display changes had no point-to-point verification and bypassed change management
existing_controls: Change requests by email to the Gas Control Manager
treatment_plan: Written SCADA change procedure with control room sign-off and point-to-point verification record; verify the two 2026 changes now

threat_event: A safety-related alarm does not trigger because its set-point or description is wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual set-point verification overdue since June 2024 plus 15 months
treatment_plan: Complete the set-point and description verification; calendar the 15-month interval in the compliance tracker

threat_event: Controller responds slowly or wrongly to loss of SCADA or false data during a cyber event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controller training does not cover cyber-caused abnormal operating conditions
existing_controls: Annual AOC tabletop; manual operation plan
treatment_plan: Add cyber AOC scenarios to the controller training program; joint tabletop with IT and field staff

threat_event: Leaders order an unnecessary or prolonged shutdown, or delay a needed one, because no decision criteria exist
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Emergency plan does not address cyber; no isolation, manual operation, or shutdown criteria; no pre-agreed customer communication
treatment_plan: Cyber annex to the emergency plan with the P08 decision tree; pre-drafted customer notices; President approves any precautionary shutdown

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a customer payment or a vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No callback verification rule for bank detail changes
treatment_plan: Callback verification for any bank detail change; finance staff training

threat_event: Stolen credentials and MFA push fatigue give an attacker access to email and SaaS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push-approval MFA; no phishing exercises
treatment_plan: Number matching on MFA prompts; phishing-resistant keys for administrators; quarterly phishing exercises

threat_event: A departed employee uses business or OT access after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business accounts disabled 3 to 5 business days after departure; OT accounts never reviewed
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR ticket for business and OT accounts; quarterly OT account review

threat_event: The MSP's remote monitoring tool is compromised and used to push ransomware to every business endpoint
threat_source: Cybercriminal group via a compromised supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM agent on every endpoint and server; no contractual security terms; SOC 2 reviewed for the first time in 2026 (P09)
existing_controls: MSP uses MFA on its tooling (per its SOC 2 report)
treatment_plan: Contract security terms and 24-hour incident notice; restrict RMM to business IT (confirmed no OT agents); annual SOC 2 review

threat_event: Nominations portal outage or breach during a gas day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS provider; no documented manual nomination procedure
existing_controls: Vendor status page; phone contact with customers
treatment_plan: Written manual nomination procedure; request the vendor's SOC 2 report

threat_event: Cloud tenant misconfiguration exposes measurement data or the historian replica
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration baseline or posture checks in the cloud tenant
existing_controls: Private network access only; MFA on the cloud console
treatment_plan: Enable the provider's configuration posture checks; quarterly review

threat_event: Attacker with cloud administrator rights deletes the business IT backup vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in a separate account but not immutable; shared administrator role
regulatory_driver: None binding (NIST CSF 2.0 benchmark); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.F.1.c)
existing_controls: Daily backups to a separate cloud account
treatment_plan: Immutable retention (30 days); break-glass administrator for the backup account only; quarterly restore test

threat_event: Employee personal information is stolen during a ransomware attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR and payroll exports stored on the file share; no egress alerting
treatment_plan: Remove HR exports from the file share; alert on large uploads

threat_event: Intruder at an unmanned valve or M&R site tampers with an RTU or local panel
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keyed locks with no key log; no door-open alarms at the 23 unmanned field sites
treatment_plan: Key log and rekeying; door-open alarm points to SCADA at the 8 valve sites

threat_event: Intruder enters the Gas Control Center or compressor station control room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badge access in place; visitor log on paper
treatment_plan: Accept; review badge access list quarterly

threat_event: Carrier cellular outage cuts SCADA visibility at 9 cellular-only sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier; no radio path at 9 sites
treatment_plan: Second-carrier SIMs at the 4 most critical cellular sites

threat_event: A hurricane knocks out power or floods the Gas Control Center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary control room in a single building; backup control room 60 miles away
existing_controls: Backup control room tested November 2025; generator at HQ
treatment_plan: Pre-storm move of controllers to the backup control room in the hurricane procedure

threat_event: The leak-detection model misses a leak, or its false alarms lead controllers to ignore alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented validation, alert thresholds, or controller guidance for the model
existing_controls: SCADA rate-of-change alarms remain primary; patrols and leakage surveys
treatment_plan: Validation and monitoring plan in P10; controller guidance that the model is advisory only

threat_event: The model vendor changes the leak-detection model without notice, and alert behavior changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change notice terms in the vendor contract
treatment_plan: Contract term requiring 30-day notice of model changes; revalidation before use

threat_event: Staff paste SCADA configurations or network diagrams into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list for generative AI
treatment_plan: Approved-tools rule in POL-05; OT information classified Restricted (POL-04)

threat_event: A vulnerable field device is missed in patching or incident response because it is not in the inventory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No complete OT asset inventory; firmware unknown for about a third of field devices
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(c)(2)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.A)
treatment_plan: Field inventory during the 2026-2027 maintenance cycle; passive discovery from the monitoring sensor

threat_event: A temporary troubleshooting rule on the IT/OT firewall is left in place and bypasses segmentation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No firewall rule review; no change record for firewall rules
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(f)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.B.2)
treatment_plan: Quarterly firewall rule review; rule changes through change management

threat_event: A field tablet with maps and saved credentials is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets encrypted; saved browser passwords allowed
treatment_plan: Accept; disable saved passwords at next policy push

threat_event: Malware on a technician's or integrator's USB drive infects an HMI or the engineering workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB ports enabled on HMIs; no media scanning station
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R04 (192.631(b)); C-ENERGY-R03 (readiness reference only; SD 02G III.D.1.d)
treatment_plan: Block USB storage on HMIs; media scanning station in the DMZ
